rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: The Insignia 10.2 Cu. Ft. Garage-Ready Chest Freezer has a removable storage basket to keep your food organized so you can find all your items. It’s easy to operate—just turn a knob to adjust the temperature.
rawPayload.Features_Legacy:
10.2 cu. ft. storage capacity

  • Gives you plenty of storage space for meat, frozen meals, treats and more.

Garage-ready

  • Works in temperatures from 0° to 110° F.

Counter-balanced hinge

  • Door can be opened and it stays at different angles from 45 degrees to 75 degrees.

Removable wire storage basket

  • Allows flexibility when arranging items or slides out to make extra room.

Defrost drain

  • Provide a path for condensate water to flow.

Adjustable leveling legs

  • Ensures your unit is level and helps with insulation.

Mechanical dial

  • Offers easy-to-use temperature control.

Power-on indicator light

  • Reassures you that your food is frozen and safe.
